name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
eligibility_facts: farmer including tenant/sharecropper growing notified crop in notified area
questions: Which crop are you growing, and in which district?
Has the crop already been damaged, or do you want insurance before loss?
temporal_note: Crop/area notification and enrolment windows are time-sensitive.

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: farmer including tenant/sharecropper growing notified crop in notified area

question.en: Are you a farmer, tenant farmer, or sharecropper growing a notified crop in a notified area?
question.or: ଆପଣ ଅଧିସୂଚିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଅଧିସୂଚିତ ଫସଲ ଚାଷ କରୁଥିବା ଚାଷୀ, ଭଡ଼ାଟିଆ ଚାଷୀ କିମ୍ବା ଭାଗଚାଷୀ କି?

description.en: Your insurable interest in the crop must be confirmed separately from cultivation and land-tenure records.
description.or: ଫସଲ ଉପରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବୀମାଯୋଗ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱାର୍ଥକୁ ଚାଷ ଏବଂ ଜମି ଅଧିକାର ରେକର୍ଡରୁ ଅଲଗା ଭାବେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ।

question.en: Do you have valid, authenticated land-ownership evidence or a valid land-tenure agreement?
question.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପାଖରେ ବୈଧ ଓ ପ୍ରମାଣିତ ଜମି ମାଲିକାନା ଦଲିଲ କିମ୍ବା ବୈଧ ଜମି ଅଧିକାର ଚୁକ୍ତି ଅଛି କି?

question.en: Can you apply for insurance within the prescribed timeframe?
question.or: ଆପଣ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ସମୟସୀମା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ବୀମା ପାଇଁ ଆବେଦନ କରିପାରିବେ କି?

description.en: Losses outside the specified crop cycle may not be covered; this is a claim-stage limitation.
description.or: ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ଫସଲ ଚକ୍ର ବାହାରର କ୍ଷତି କଭର୍ ନ ହୋଇପାରେ; ଏହା ଦାବି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟର ସୀମାବଦ୍ଧତା।

description.en: Coverage depends on payment of the required premium; non-payment can cancel the insurance.
description.or: ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ପ୍ରିମିୟମ୍ ଦେବା ଉପରେ କଭରେଜ୍ ନିର୍ଭର କରେ; ପ୍ରିମିୟମ୍ ନ ଦେଲେ ବୀମା ବାତିଲ ହୋଇପାରେ।
